title: One shared inclusion tensor comparison preserves the individual compact-support projection mates
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, coefficient datum $C$, and $H:\mathrm{SixFunctorCommonStages}(D,C)$ [def-sf-operation-stages]. Fix a finite coefficient field $E$. Write $B_E(X)$ for its rational stage, $B_\infty(X)$ for the common-stage category, and $i_X:B_E(X)\to B_\infty(X)$ for inclusion [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Write $S_E,T_E,A_E$ and $S_\infty,T_\infty,A_\infty$ for the specified push stages, tensors and exchange data. There exists a single family of natural isomorphisms $t_X:(T_E(X)\text{ uncurried});i_X\cong(i_X\times i_X);(T_\infty(X)\text{ uncurried})$ with this property. For every $f:X\to Y$, every compactification $c$ of $f$, and $K\in B_E(X)$, $L\in B_E(Y)$, inclusion of the specified compact-support projection [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] commutes with these tensor comparisons and the prescribed operation comparisons $H.\mathrm{commonStageComparison}(E)$. Explicitly, with the source and target endpoint isomorphisms of [lem-sf-rational-projection-tensor-compatibility], $i_Y(\pi^E_{f,c}(K,L));\mathrm{target}_{f,c,K,L}=\mathrm{source}_{f,c,K,L};\pi^\infty_{f,c}(i_XK,i_YL)$. Semicolon means composition in displayed order. This concerns only one projection arrow at a time; it assumes no finite-stage coherence law, and asserts no compactification, composition, pentagon or proper-coincidence equation.

source.place: Compatibility and the common finite coefficient-field paragraph: flat extension of scalars respects the units, counits, associativity and specified projection mate.

proof.text: Construct the canonical natural tensor comparison independently of f and c, by the finite-stage tensor representative formula and the repeated-stage scalar unit.
Factor the specified projection through the proper-image tensor object. Apply the inclusion preservation square for the proper counit factor and the initial support identification.
Apply the inclusion preservation square for proper image of the open projection and the final support identification. It uses exactly the same canonical tensorator and middle comparison.

Apply functoriality to the factorization. Reassociate, replace the open square, reassociate, replace the proper square, and recombine the common factors. This gives exactly the required source/target square.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility, with the two proper/open factors made explicit and composed in Lean.

theorem commonProjectionTensorCompatibility
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    (H : SixFunctorCommonStages D C)
    (E₀ : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields C.l C.Qbar) :
    ∃ t : ∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
      Functor.uncurry.obj ((H.coefficientStages E₀).rationalTensor X) ⋙
          GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
            (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := X.obj.left) E₀ ≅
        (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
            (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := X.obj.left) E₀).prod
          (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
            (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := X.obj.left) E₀) ⋙
          Functor.uncurry.obj (H.commonStageTensor X),
      ∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
        (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
        (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage C.l C.Qbar X.obj.left E₀)
        (L : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage C.l C.Qbar Y.obj.left E₀),
        (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
            (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Y.obj.left) E₀).map
            (compactSupportProjectionComponent (H.coefficientStages E₀).rationalExchange
              f c K L) ≫
          (target (H.commonStageComparison E₀) t f c K L).hom =
        (source (H.commonStageComparison E₀) t f c K L).hom ≫
          compactSupportProjectionComponent H.commonStageExchange f c
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
              (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := X.obj.left) E₀).obj K)
            ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
              (l := C.l) (Ω := C.Qbar) (Y := Y.obj.left) E₀).obj L)
